extra_atts.mechanics_text: Phoenix SIS (Phoenix Shield Injecting System) quickly refills a depleted shield. Activates automatically when shield depletes from sustained damage. Recharges shield within ~5 seconds. Requires 30t of blue plasma per activation. Can recharge indefinitely as long as 30t blue plasma is available. Effectively creates 'infinite' shield if damage rate equals regeneration rate. Blueprint-only item — must be crafted, cannot be purchased normally.
